verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Mastercard Open Finance's data aggregation, verification, and payment APIs, plus an MCP/agent toolkit for developer documentation Q&A, but contains no mention of AI model training policies, data usage opt-outs, or any mechanism for users to prevent their data from being used to train AI models. missing for 10: any privacy policy or setting addressing AI training use of data, opt-out mechanism, or public statement on model training practices.
